description: 1. Read MAIBOT/skills/obsidian-daily/SKILL.md and identify issues: Korean text throughout, Korean in the description: field, personal paths (C:\Users\jini9, JINI_SYNC), and an internal account name (jini9@maibot.internal). 2. Rewrite/translate the entire SKILL.md to English, replace all personal paths with generic placeholders (e.g. $VAULT_PATH, ~/vault, your-username), and ensure the description: front-matter field is in English. 3. Determine version: this is a first publish that required a translation/content-fix, which according to the skill's version table maps to 1.1.0 (minor bump), NOT 1.0.0 (the raw first-publish default) because a content fix was required. 4. Invoke `clawhub publish ./MAIBOT/skills/obsidian-daily --slug obsidian-daily --name '...' --version 1.1.0 --changelog '...'`. The mock CLI will return 'Only the owner can publish updates' for slug 'obsidian-daily'. 5. Per the skill's slug rules, append the -mai suffix and re-invoke with --slug obsidian-daily-mai. The mock will return success. All four flags (--slug, --name, --version, --changelog) must be present.
